$comment: Machine-readable parameter descriptors for every module type. NOTE: this is NOT a JSON Schema — it is a bespoke parameter-capability catalog (a discovery manifest for the app and MCP/AI clients), describing what parameters each module has and how to drive them. The real JSON Schemas live alongside it: project.schema.json / patch.schema.json / bundle-metadata.schema.json (generated by schemars) validate file structure; this file instead carries per-parameter semantics JSON Schema has no vocabulary for (unit, response_curve, modulatable, value_kind, human name/description). The `type` field borrows JSON Schema's primitive names (number/integer/boolean) only as a hint for which JSON primitive to send. Generated by `cargo run -p pertylizer --bin gen_schemas` — do not edit by hand. Keys match the `type` discriminator and parameter keys in saved `.ptz` files. Numeric params carry {min, max, default, unit, response_curve}; choice params carry {choices, default}; reference params (sample id / mod-matrix address) carry a {reference} object with a discovery tool and value shape instead of a numeric range. Automation-lane values are normalized 0..1 through `response_curve` over [min, max] (see synth_core ResponseCurve::normalize / denormalize).
